verdict.rationale: Whether a messaging platform's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Customer.io publishing its source under an open license. The docs describe a proprietary SaaS reached through APIs, a CLI, an MCP server and an OpenAPI spec, and none of these amounts to open product source. The only open-source mention is a third-party alternative a developer built instead of using Customer.io, which says nothing in this product's favor.
